related.title: 潮流渦輪機海床固定系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「大小潮的功率差異」與「出口電纜的損失」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；潮流渦輪機海床固定系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Power difference between springs and neaps" and "Loss in the export cable" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Tidal Turbine Seabed Mounting Systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦放在海峽急流裡的渦輪機：大小潮的三次方、推力、憩流時窗、出口電纜與陣列密度；潮流渦輪機海床固定系統則以把渦輪機固定在急流的海床上：傾覆力矩、重力基座、鑽孔樁、沖刷與作業時窗為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on turbines set in a racing strait: the cube law at springs and neaps, thrust, slack-water windows, export cables and array density; Tidal Turbine Seabed Mounting Systems centres on fixing a turbine to the seabed in a tidal race: overturning moment, gravity bases, drilled piles, scour and working windows, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「潮流功率密度」與「潮流功率密度」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「重力式基座的抗滑穩定」的模型移到潮流渦輪機海床固定系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「葉片通過頻率」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Power of a tidal stream" and "Power of a tidal stream".
Move the model of "Sliding stability of a gravity base" to Tidal Turbine Seabed Mounting Systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Blade-passing frequency", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「大小潮的功率差異」與「出口電纜的損失」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；潮流渦輪機海床固定系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Power difference between springs and neaps" and "Loss in the export cable" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Tidal Turbine Seabed Mounting Systems must be respecified.

related.title: 錫赫瓦潮汐發電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「大小潮的功率差異」與「出口電纜的損失」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；錫赫瓦潮汐發電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Power difference between springs and neaps" and "Loss in the export cable" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Sihwa Lake Tidal Power Station must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦放在海峽急流裡的渦輪機：大小潮的三次方、推力、憩流時窗、出口電纜與陣列密度；錫赫瓦潮汐發電站則以借用既有海堤的世界最大潮汐電廠：實際擷取比例、水輪機流量、換水與閘門為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on turbines set in a racing strait: the cube law at springs and neaps, thrust, slack-water windows, export cables and array density; Sihwa Lake Tidal Power Station centres on the world's largest tidal plant on an existing seawall: share captured, turbine flow, water exchange and sluices, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「潮流功率密度」與「潮差蓄能」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「重力式基座的抗滑穩定」的模型移到錫赫瓦潮汐發電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「每潮的換水比例」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Power of a tidal stream" and "Energy from tidal range".
Move the model of "Sliding stability of a gravity base" to Sihwa Lake Tidal Power Station, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Water exchanged each tide", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「大小潮的功率差異」與「出口電纜的損失」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；錫赫瓦潮汐發電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Power difference between springs and neaps" and "Loss in the export cable" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Sihwa Lake Tidal Power Station must be respecified.

history.text: 2016 年首部渦輪機送電；2018 年第一期進入長期運轉；2022 年擴建容量取得差價合約。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2016: The first turbine exported power. 2018: The first phase entered long-term operation. 2022: Expansion capacity won contracts for difference. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
